content.name: Step of the Wind
entries: You can spend 1 ki point to take the {@action Disengage} or {@action Dash} action as a bonus action on your turn, and your jump distance is doubled for the turn.

content.name: Step of the Wind
entries: You can take the {@action Dash|SRD52} action as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}. Alternatively, you can expend 1 Focus Point to take both the {@action Disengage|SRD52} and {@action Dash|SRD52} actions as a {@variantrule Bonus Action|SRD52}, and your jump distance is doubled for the turn.
